programme.desc: The gorgeous and talented Ann-Margret says she disguises herself in a black wig when out in public. Screen legend Robert Mitchem reveals he did time on a chain gang, at age 15.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (12/10/81)
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau regale Johnny with tales of making 5 movies together and one near-death stunt gone very wrong.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (3/23/82)
programme.desc: Stardom is bad for your health. Walter Matthau dons dark glasses to disguise an eye problem, jokes about his roommate in the hospital and the awful food.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Sean Connery (10/5/83)
programme.desc: Sean Connery gives a Bond trivia quiz, and recalls his scariest stunts. Comic Keenan Ivory Wayans says dating white girls is like being on Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom; people can't stop staring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Mickey Rooney (3/13/84)
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney compares notes with Johnny on their many marriages. Comic Paul Rodriguez riffs on Mexicans picking fruit and the fun of annoying white drivers on LA freeways.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (7/22/86)
programme.desc: We're spelling tonight! Walter Matthau and Johnny quiz one another on difficult words. Matthau recalls filming Tunisia and shows a clip from his movie, Pirates.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (6/22/88)
programme.desc: Hog wild: That's Jay Leno who owns 17 motorcycles. Leno describes a chopper breakdown in LA with a busload of tourists cheering him on. Raquel Welch discusses her children and getting older.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dennis Hopper (8/15/91)
programme.desc: Not your typical leading man, Dennis Hopper talks about his unusual roles in Blue Velvet and Easy Rider, and his up and down career which began in his Kansas hometown.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dennis Hopper (8/15/91)
programme.desc: Not your typical leading man, Dennis Hopper talks about his unusual roles in Blue Velvet and Easy Rider, and his up and down career which began in his Kansas hometown.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Clint Eastwood (5/15/92)
programme.desc: Mr. "make-my-day" Clint Eastwood reminisces about Gunsmoke, Outlaw Josey Wales and Dirty Harry, while Bob Hope and David Letterman also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Jane Fonda (10/6/77)
programme.desc: Activist and two-time Oscar winner Jane Fonda details her suit against the US government for invading her privacy. Also plugs her move, "Julia."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dean Martin (12/12/75)
programme.desc: Star party guy, Dean Martin recounts the wild fun celebrating Frank Sinatra's big 6-0. Also fills in Johnny on playing Las Vegas and his frequent forays into the casinos.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Joey Bishop (2/24/76)
programme.desc: Brat packer & longtime TV personality Joey Bishop talks about his career, politics, how he gave up smoking and lost weight.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (11/21/80)
programme.desc: The great actress and great beauty Raquel Welch chats about Presidents Reagan and Carter, her 2nd marriage, getting negative press and how she imagines her life in the year 2000.
